storyCards.headline: Dreaming Of You: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Selena's "Dreaming Of You" reached #22 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Dreaming of You" is a song recorded by American Tejano singer Selena and released by EMI Latin on August 14, 1995, as the title track and third single from her fifth and final studio album Dreaming of You.

The song peaked at #22 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Dreaming Of You was released in 1995.
